This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

One-Pot Chicken Fajita Rice Skillet Recipe  Ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 onion, sliced 3 bell peppers, sliced into strips yellow, red & green 2 chicken breasts, sliced into strips 1 packet fajita seasoning 1 tablespoon garlic 1 can Rotel, undrained 1 cup rice, washed  1 teaspoon tomato bouillon 2 cups chicken broth Queso: 1 can green chiles 1 small can evaporated milk (5 oz) ½ pound white American cheese slices, from the deli Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and bell peppers and cook until softened. Add the sliced chicken and fajita seasoning. Stir to coat everything and cook until the chicken is fully cooked through. Add the garlic and Rotel. Stir to combine. Add the rice, chicken broth, and tomato bouillon. Stir everything together. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and cook for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. While the rice cooks, make the queso. Add the evaporated milk, green chiles, and the white American cheese to a small saucepan over low heat. Stir until the cheese is completely melted and the queso is smooth. Fluff the rice, then pour the queso evenly over the top. Serve hot. #OnePotMeals #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe #WeeknightDinner #MealIdeas

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken & Rice Bake A delicious one-pan dinner featuring juicy chicken coated in a sweet, sticky honey garlic glaze, baked over fluffy seasoned rice with carrots and topped with green onions. 55–65 minutes Ingredients For the chicken: 1½ lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs or breasts ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp olive oil For the honey garlic sauce: ⅓ cup honey ¼ cup soy sauce 4 garlic cloves, minced 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp grated ginger 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water For the rice: 1½ cups uncooked long-grain white rice 2¼ cups chicken broth 1 medium carrot, diced ½ cup chopped onion 1 tbsp butter ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 2 green onions, chopped (garnish) Instructions 1. Preheat oven: Set your oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Season chicken: Toss chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and olive oil. 3. Prepare rice: Spread uncooked rice in a greased baking dish. Add carrots, onions, butter, chicken broth, salt, and pepper. Stir together. 4. Prepare sauce: In a saucepan, combine honey, soy sauce, garlic, ketchup, vinegar, and ginger. Simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in cornstarch slurry and cook until slightly thickened. 5. Assemble: Place seasoned chicken over the rice and brush generously with honey garlic sauce, reserving some sauce for serving. 6. Bake: Cover tightly with foil and bake for 35–40 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 10–15 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 165°F internally. 7. Finish: Brush with reserved sauce (reheat it first if it touched raw chicken). Broil for 2–3 minutes until golden and sticky, watching carefully. 8. Serve: Sprinkle with chopped green onions and serve hot. Tip: If the rice needs more time, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking. For a glossy restaurant-style finish, brush the chicken with extra honey garlic glaze just before serving. This is a homemade version inspired by the dish shown, rather than the creator's confirmed recipe. Similar chicken-and-rice bakes use a covered-then-uncovered baking method.  #HoneyGarlicChicken ##HoneyGarlicChickeny#ChickenAndRice#EasyDinnerRecipesghts ##foodseasytomake

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Roasted Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Rice Bake🔥598 cals 62g protein 21g fat 38g carbs Ingredients: This makes 4 meals 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed 1 cup dry jasmine rice (185g) 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block (8oz) reduced-fat cream cheese ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese  1 whole garlic bulb 1 tsp olive oil Fresh parsley for garnish Seasoning blend: 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°. In a 9×13 baking dish, add your uncooked jasmine rice and chicken broth. Stir everything together and spread the rice evenly across the bottom. 2. In a large bowl, add your cubed chicken breast along with the entire seasoning blend. Toss thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated. 3. Place your seasoned chicken evenly on top of the rice mixture, keeping the tops of the chicken exposed. Slice the top off your whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and place it cut-side up alongside the chicken. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. 4. Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. If the rice is still firm, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking until tender. 5. Remove the foil and squeeze the softened garlic cloves into the rice. Add your reduced-fat cream cheese and grated parmesan cheese, then mix everything into the hot rice until melted and creamy 6. Return to the oven uncovered for another 5–8 minutes. For a golden finish, broil for the final 1–2 minutes, watching closely. Garnish with fresh parsley, divide evenly into 6 meals, and enjoy! Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Cream Chicken Over Biscuits Recipe Ingredients: 1 rotisserie chicken, shredded 2 tbsp butter 2 tbsp all purpose flour 2 cups water or chicken broth 1 tsp chicken bouillon Cheddar Bay Biscuits, prepared according to package instructions Mashed potatoes, for serving Seasonings: Dried parsley Garlic powder Onion powder Poultry seasoning Paprika Directions: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Add the flour and stir well, letting it cook for about 2 minutes. Pour in the water or chicken broth and stir until smooth. Season to taste with parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, poultry seasoning, and paprika. Stir in the chicken bouillon and give everything a good stir. Add the shredded rotisserie chicken and stir until everything is combined. Cover and let simmer for several minutes until the chicken is heated through and the gravy thickens to your liking. Prepare the Cheddar Bay Biscuits according to the package instructions. Serve the chicken gravy over mashed potatoes with biscuits on the side, or spoon it right over the biscuits! Loaded Bacon Green Beans Recipe Ingredients: 2 cans green beans, drained 2 slices thick cut bacon, chopped 1 tbsp butter 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp low sodium soy sauce Garlic powder Black pepper Directions: Cook the chopped bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy. Leave the bacon and bacon grease in the pan, then add the butter, drained green beans, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic powder, and black pepper. Stir everything together, cover, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, while you prepare the rest of dinner. Let the flavors come together until the green beans are tender! This easy chicken and gravy recipe is easy to make and the whole family loves it! INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. 3. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat evenly. 4. Add sliced onion, pour 2 cups of chicken broth over everything, and add fresh thyme. 5. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 6. 🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Ingredients Chicken & Rice Bake 1½ pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces 3 cups cooked white rice 2 cups broccoli florets 1 cup diced carrots 1 red bell pepper, chopped ½ red onion, chopped ½ cup frozen peas 2 green onions, thinly sliced 1 tablespoon sesame seeds (optional) Homemade Teriyaki Sauce ½ cup low-sodium soy sauce ⅓ cup honey or brown sugar ¼ cup water 2 tablespoons rice vinegar 1 tablespoon sesame oil 3 garlic cloves, minced 1 teaspoon freshly grated ginger 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons water Instructions Preheat your oven to 375°F and lightly coat a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray or a thin layer of oil.
